subject: Understanding specific values in plot builder

messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: Understanding specific values in plot builder
parts:
When using a geometric element, let say, geom_crossbar, there is an option to use a specific values in "mappings", but I tried specific values without using variables and is not working (I donn't get any plot).

Am I missing something in the setting?

Best,

Manuel Spínola

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Understanding specific values in plot builder
parts:
you can put whatever you want as an aes by right clicking on the
variable drop field. Setting the mapping to a specific value is done
by toggling away the drop field and using the gui component that pops
up.

If nothing is happening you have likely entered something invalid. you
can use "view call" to see what is going wrong with the plot.

ian
